title: At the police station
instructions: Adam polise kayıp cüzdanını bildiriyor. Uzun bir diyalog; düzeltilen bilgilere ve cüzdanın içindekilere dikkat et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: Good afternoon. How can I help you?

script.speaker: adam
script.text: I lost my wallet this morning.

script.speaker: adam
script.text: I was on the bus, the number nine. No, sorry, the number nineteen.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: What does your wallet look like?

script.speaker: adam
script.text: It's brown and small. It's made of leather.

script.speaker: adam
script.text: My bank card, my ID card and about thirty pounds. And a photo of my children.

script.speaker: adam
script.text: No, my phone is here, in my pocket.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: OK. Please write your name and phone number here. We'll call you if we find it.

questions.prompt: When did Adam lose his wallet?
questions.evidence: I lost my wallet this morning.
